title: Filter by IP address
description: Show packets where either the source or destination IP matches.

title: Filter by source IP
description: Show packets only where the source IP matches.

title: Filter by destination IP
description: Show packets only where the destination IP matches.

title: Filter by subnet
description: Show packets to/from any address within a CIDR subnet.

title: Filter by TCP port
description: Show TCP packets where either the source or destination port matches.

title: Filter by UDP port
description: Show UDP packets where either the source or destination port matches.

title: HTTP traffic only
description: Show only packets carrying HTTP request/response data.

title: HTTP GET requests
description: Show only HTTP GET requests.

title: HTTP POST requests
description: Show only HTTP POST requests — often worth inspecting for exfiltrated data or credentials.

title: HTTP response status errors
description: Show HTTP responses with a 4xx or 5xx status code.

title: DNS traffic only
description: Show only DNS query/response packets.

title: DNS queries for a domain
description: Show DNS queries whose name contains a substring — useful for hunting suspicious domains.

title: FTP traffic only
description: Show only FTP control-channel packets (commands/responses).

title: FTP credentials in cleartext
description: Show FTP PASS commands, which carry the password in cleartext — a classic finding to flag.

title: SMTP traffic only
description: Show only SMTP (email submission) packets.

title: TLS/SSL handshake
description: Show packets that are part of a TLS handshake (ClientHello, ServerHello, certificates, etc).

title: TLS ClientHello (SNI)
description: Show TLS ClientHello packets, which contain the SNI hostname the client is requesting — visible even over encrypted traffic.

title: TCP SYN packets
description: Show only TCP connection-initiation (SYN) packets, useful for spotting scan activity.

title: TCP RST packets
description: Show TCP reset packets, often indicating a refused/aborted connection.

title: TCP retransmissions
description: Show packets Wireshark has flagged as TCP retransmissions — a sign of packet loss or a struggling link.

title: TCP duplicate ACKs
description: Show duplicate ACKs, often a precursor to fast-retransmit and a sign of packet loss.

title: ICMP traffic only
description: Show only ICMP packets (ping, traceroute, unreachable/error messages).

title: ICMP echo requests/replies
description: Show ping request (type 8) and reply (type 0) packets specifically.

title: ARP traffic only
description: Show only ARP request/reply packets.

title: Possible ARP spoofing
description: Show packets Wireshark flags as a duplicate IP/MAC pairing — a strong ARP-spoofing indicator.

title: Filter by MAC address
description: Show packets where either the source or destination MAC matches.

title: Exclude a protocol (negation)
description: Hide noisy background protocols like ARP and ICMP to focus on the traffic that matters.

title: Filter by packet size
description: Show packets larger than a given byte length — useful for spotting large exfil transfers.

title: Filter by frame number
description: Jump directly to a specific packet number, handy when cross-referencing with another tool's output.

title: HTTP User-Agent contains
description: Show HTTP requests whose User-Agent header contains a given substring, e.g. flagging scripted clients.

title: Contains a string anywhere in the packet
description: Search the full raw packet bytes for a text string, across any protocol/layer.

title: TCP stream follow filter
description: Isolate every packet belonging to one TCP conversation/stream index.

title: Kerberos traffic
description: Show Kerberos authentication packets — central to Active Directory auth troubleshooting/hunting.

title: SMB/CIFS traffic
description: Show SMB2/3 (Windows file-sharing) protocol packets.

title: SMB named pipe access
description: Show SMB2 traffic referencing IPC$ named pipes, often used in lateral-movement tooling.

title: DHCP traffic
description: Show DHCP lease request/offer/ack traffic (bootp in older Wireshark versions).

title: NTP traffic
description: Show Network Time Protocol packets.

title: SNMP traffic
description: Show SNMP management/monitoring packets.

title: SNMP community string in cleartext
description: Show SNMP packets, exposing the community string field — SNMPv1/2c send this in cleartext.

title: VLAN-tagged traffic
description: Show 802.1Q VLAN-tagged frames.

title: Filter by specific VLAN ID
description: Show frames tagged with a specific VLAN ID.

title: Malformed / expert-flagged packets
description: Show any packet Wireshark's expert system has flagged as anomalous (retransmission, out-of-order, zero window, etc).

title: TCP zero window
description: Show packets announcing a zero receive window — the receiver's buffer is full and cannot accept more data.

title: HTTP requests to a specific host
description: Show HTTP requests whose Host header matches exactly.

title: Filter by TLS SNI value
description: Show TLS ClientHello packets requesting a specific hostname via SNI.

title: Filter by TCP flags (PSH+ACK)
description: Show packets with exactly the PSH and ACK flags set, common for data-carrying segments.

title: Filter out a specific IP
description: Hide all traffic to/from a given IP, e.g. excluding a noisy monitoring host.

title: Bootp/DHCP option 12 hostname
description: Show the client hostname advertised in a DHCP request — quick way to inventory devices on a capture.

title: QUIC traffic
description: Show QUIC (HTTP/3 transport) packets, increasingly common with modern browsers.

title: Filter TLS by version
description: Show TLS records using a specific protocol version (0x0301 = TLS 1.0) — useful for spotting legacy/weak TLS still in use.
